title: Tenable Joins Cisco’s SolutionsPlus Program as an Exposure Management Partner for Vulnerability Management Customers
author: Tenable Holdings, Inc.
description: Tenable has joined Cisco's SolutionsPlus program to provide exposure management capabilities to Cisco vulnerability management customers. The partnership enables seamless migration to Tenable One platform, offering unified exposure data, AI-powered insights through Hexa AI, and professional services support for smooth transition.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Tenable announced a strategic partnership with Cisco that expands its market reach to Cisco's customer base. The partnership provides a clear modernization path for customers and positions Tenable's exposure management platform as an industry-leading solution, supporting business growth and customer acquisition.

While Cisco benefits from the partnership by offering customers an advanced exposure management solution through its SolutionsPlus program, the announcement primarily highlights Tenable's capabilities and positioning. The partnership is presented as a customer service enhancement rather than a significant strategic win for Cisco.

title: Worldwide Digital Railway Market to Reach $136.49 Billion by 2031 as IoT, AI and Cloud Adoption Accelerate
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global digital railway market is projected to grow from $90.98 billion in 2026 to $136.49 billion by 2031, with a CAGR of 8.5%. Growth is driven by rising passenger volumes, IoT adoption, and cloud-based rail management systems. Passenger Information Systems will record the highest growth, while remote monitoring holds the largest market share. Asia-Pacific is identified as the fastest-growing region, supported by smart-city investments and advanced signaling systems.

title: CallTower and CEO Bret England Honored with Innovation Excellence Award 2026
author: Not Specified
description: CallTower, a global unified communications and contact center managed service provider, has been recognized with the Innovation Excellence Award 2026 alongside CEO Bret England. The award honors the company's 14-year track record of helping organizations modernize communications through integrated UC, CC/CX, and AI solutions across multiple platforms including Microsoft Teams, Webex, and Zoom.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Microsoft Teams is mentioned as one of the platforms CallTower integrates, indicating a partnership relationship. However, the mention is purely contextual without specific commentary on Microsoft's performance or strategy.
Webex by Cisco is referenced as one of the integrated collaboration platforms. The mention is neutral and factual, indicating a technology partnership without additional sentiment indicators.
